quiz.readyDesc: Responde 10 preguntas sobre dinosaurios. ¡Elige la respuesta correcta y aprende un dato dino genial después de cada una!

rules.text: Play as many times as you like!

facts.title: Datos Dino Increíbles
facts.subtitle: ¡Aprende algo asombroso sobre el mundo prehistórico!

items.title: T. rex Teeth
items.body: T. rex had 60 teeth, each one as long as a banana! They could crunch through bone like it was nothing.

items.title: Dino Eggs
items.body: Dinosaurs laid eggs just like birds and reptiles do today. Some nests had up to 20 eggs in them!

items.title: Fossils Everywhere
items.body: Dinosaur fossils have been found on every single continent, even icy Antarctica!

items.title: Living Dinos
items.body: Birds are actually real dinosaurs! They evolved from feathered theropods millions of years ago.

items.title: Hollow Bones
items.body: Many dinosaurs had hollow bones, just like birds today. This made them lighter and faster!

items.title: Warm or Cold?
items.body: Scientists now think many dinosaurs were warm-blooded and very active, not slow and sluggish!

types.title: Conoce a los Dinos
types.subtitle: Los dinosaurios vinieron en todas las formas y tamaños. ¡Aquí hay tres grupos increíbles!

items.name: Meat Eaters
items.desc: Carnivores like T. rex and Velociraptor hunted other animals. They had sharp teeth and claws!

items.name: Plant Eaters
items.desc: Herbivores like Brachiosaurus and Triceratops munched on plants all day. Some were HUGE!

items.name: Flying Reptiles
items.desc: Pterosaurs soared through the sky! They weren't dinosaurs but lived at the same time.

cta.title: ¡Desafía a Tus Amigos!
